caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, carved metal or stone tablet displayed on a plain light background. The tablet has a weathered brownish-gray color with defined edges and a crack running vertically through its center. The upper half of the tablet contains two semicircular arched panels: the left panel holds a stylized heart shape with circular markings inside, surrounded by vine-like decorations, and the right panel displays a symmetrical floral or leafy motif with a central stem and radiating elements. Above the floral design, the numbers “6” and “3” are positioned on either side, while the letters "EN SON" are engraved below within the same section. Beneath these arched panels, a horizontal band contains the name "GEORGE ROSS GEORGES" in capital letters. Below this, another band in all capitals reads "MARY ANN FURNACE" with "WILLIAM THOMPSON" below it, staggered and occupying a carved border. The carving is surrounded by a raised rectangular frame, and various decorative geometric and plant-like motifs fill the background spaces of the tablet. The overall composition is symmetrical and features clear, deeply incised lettering and iconography.
title: Pennsylvania German Fireback
